description: Find or browse skills. With a `query`, finds the skill for a specific tax topic by keyword: a deduction, form, regime or rule such as 'home office deduction', 'Schedule C', 'reverse charge', 'crypto capital gains' or 'Beckham regime'. Without a query, lists the skills for a jurisdiction, domain or role (for example every skill for 'MT', or every 'payroll' skill), each with its current approval label, 100 at a time (limit up to 200; page with offset and next_offset). Optionally limit either to one jurisdiction or domain. Returns skill slugs to open with get_skill. Set content_type='method' to find step-by-step methods (run them via start), each tagged accountant-reviewed or source-cited.

content_type.description: What kind of skill to find. 'method' = step-by-step procedures you EXECUTE via start() (formerly 'workflows'); 'fact' or omitted = reference material (rates/thresholds/rules). A skill can be either or both.

domain.description: Optional accounting domain to limit the search (e.g. 'vat-gst', 'payroll', 'income-tax', 'financial-reporting', 'audit-assurance').

jurisdiction.description: Optional ISO 2-letter country code to limit the search

limit.description: When browsing: skills per page (default 100, max 200).

offset.description: When browsing: skills to skip; pass next_offset from the previous page.

query.description: Search term in English, e.g. 'home office deduction', 'crypto capital gains', 'reverse charge'. If the user wrote in another language, translate it and add the local term, e.g. 'VAT return btw-aangifte'. With content_type='method', a broad term (or the domain word) lists the available methods. Omit it to list (browse) the skills for a jurisdiction, domain or role instead.

role.description: Optional, when browsing: foundation, compute, orchestrator or reference.

name: search_skills

closest_skills.description: On a miss inside one jurisdiction: skills that jurisdiction does have.

human_backing.description: Named accountant(s) who review this jurisdiction's guidance (guidance-level, not a per-figure sign-off).

mode.description: Present when there was no query: the results are a browse, in catalogue order.

next_offset.description: Browse only: present when more skills remain; pass as offset.

approval.description: Current public professional approval. Use label verbatim; source/fact checks do not grant approval.

label.description: Approved by [name], or Not yet approved.

tier.description: 1 = current public accountant approval, 2 = Not yet approved.

title: Search tax skills by topic
